Lock around the shared counter makes sense as a fix — but did the existing suite actually catch the race before, or is it just green because it's not the kind of thing a normal test run would hit anyway? Race conditions are timing-dependent, so "tests pass" post-fix doesn't tell us much unless one of them was actually driving concurrent access to the counter.

Is there a test that spins up multiple workers hammering the queue concurrently and asserts the counter ends up correct? If not, worth adding one specifically — otherwise we're trusting the lock is right by inspection, not by evidence it would've failed pre-fix.
